notes.title: v90.5
notes.notes:
Fixed some assets
Further tweaked the spider, so that it can now latch on to bats as well, albeit, poisoning and killing said bat after a set amount of time
Snakes now kill spider, rather than the other way around
Added more spiders to the levels
Spiders now stun all human enemies proper
Fixed some minor bugs, such as the left-most wall on level 4 and a few texture-bugs by the waterfall on level 3

Zorra can now use all weapons

Highscore finally working again!

notes.title: Fixed tutorial level, added thumbstick support and more
notes.notes:
This was a long overdue patch. I am trying to find time to work on 2tinycowboys and will try to keep it as 'unbroken' as possible. This should hopefully address whatever problems people would have had with the tutorial-level. Do note that once you 'win' the tutorial, however, you will need to press 'escxape' in order to return to main menu, as I have not yet implemented a high-score table for the tutorial-level.

All else should be perfectly functional now; Felipe seemed to have had some issues, which should be resolved.
